newsitem.title: USA: GalaGen secures $2 million credit line.
newsitem.headline: GalaGen secures $2 million credit line.

text.p: GalaGen Inc, a medical research company, said Thursday it set up a $2 million line-of-credit with Transamerica Business Credit Corp which extends through June 1998.
Advances are payable over a period of four years and are secured by the company's fixed assets.
The funds will be used primarily to finance plant improvements and equipment.

"This financing strengthens our company and allows us to better allocate our cash resources to support our pharmaceutical clinical trials and development efforts in functional foods," said Robert Hoerr, M.D., Ph.D., president and chief executive officer of GalaGen, in a statement.
